SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ddd1(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  genericname varchar(100) NOT NULL,
	mg  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg10  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg11  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg12  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg1  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg2  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg3  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg4  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg5  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg6  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg7  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg8  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg9  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	dd  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd10  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd11  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd12  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd1  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd2  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd3  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd4  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd5  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd6  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd7  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd8  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd9  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,genericname),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year),
	KEY (genericname)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ddd1 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ddd1
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode,CONCAT(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
			,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,genericname
,SUM(a.mgTotal) mg
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(10), a.mgTotal,0)) mg10
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(11), a.mgTotal,0)) mg11
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(12), a.mgTotal,0)) mg12
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(1), a.mgTotal,0)) mg1
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(2), a.mgTotal,0)) mg2
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(3), a.mgTotal,0)) mg3
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(4), a.mgTotal,0)) mg4
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(5), a.mgTotal,0)) mg5
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(6), a.mgTotal,0)) mg6
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(7), a.mgTotal,0)) mg7
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(8), a.mgTotal,0)) mg8
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(9), a.mgTotal,0)) mg9
,SUM(a.mgTotal/a.O) dd
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(10), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd10
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(11), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd11
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(12), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd12
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(1), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd1
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(2), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd2
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(3), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd3
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(4), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd4
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(5), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd5
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(6), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd6
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(7), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd7
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(8), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd8
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATE_SERV,'%m') in(9), (a.mgTotal/a.O),0)) dd9
FROM s_1ddd_opvisit o
				INNER JOIN chospital h ON o.hospcode=h.hoscode
				INNER JOIN t_ddd_op a ON o.hospcode=a.hospcode
WHERE a.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND o.b_year=(@b_year+543)
GROUP BY h.hoscode,a.GenericName
);

SELECT c.genericname,w.O as ddds
,o.op,mg,((dd*1000)/o.op) ddd
,o.op10,mg10,((dd10*1000)/o.op10) ddd10
,o.op11,mg11,((dd11*1000)/o.op11) ddd11
,o.op12,mg12,((dd12*1000)/o.op12) ddd12
,o.op1,mg1,((dd1*1000)/o.op1) ddd1
,o.op2,mg2,((dd2*1000)/o.op2) ddd2
,o.op3,mg3,((dd3*1000)/o.op3) ddd3
,o.op4,mg4,((dd4*1000)/o.op4) ddd4
,o.op5,mg5,((dd5*1000)/o.op5) ddd5
,o.op6,mg6,((dd6*1000)/o.op6) ddd6
,o.op7,mg7,((dd7*1000)/o.op7) ddd7
,o.op8,mg8,((dd8*1000)/o.op8) ddd8
,o.op9,mg9,((dd9*1000)/o.op9) ddd9
FROM catb_ddd c INNER JOIN cwho_ddd w ON c.DrugDDD_Mapping=w.DrugDDD_Mapping AND SUBSTR(c.DIDSTD19,17,1) IN(2)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT genericname, SUM(mg) mg,SUM(mg10) mg10,SUM(mg11) mg11,SUM(mg12) mg12
,SUM(mg1) mg1,SUM(mg2) mg2,SUM(mg3) mg3,SUM(mg4) mg4,SUM(mg5) mg5
,SUM(mg6) mg6,SUM(mg7) mg7,SUM(mg8) mg8,SUM(mg9) mg9
, SUM(dd) dd,SUM(dd10) dd10,SUM(dd11) dd11,SUM(dd12) dd12
,SUM(dd1) dd1,SUM(dd2) dd2,SUM(dd3) dd3,SUM(dd4) dd4,SUM(dd5) dd5
,SUM(dd6) dd6,SUM(dd7) dd7,SUM(dd8) dd8,SUM(dd9) dd9
FROM  {tablename}  {sjoin}
INNER JOIN chospital h ON {tablename}.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE  b_year= '{year}' {where} {hospcode} {cmihospcode} {DEP} {fzyymm}
GROUP BY genericname
) s ON  s.genericname=c.genericname
,(SELECT SUM(op) op,SUM(op10) op10,SUM(op11) op11,SUM(op12) op12 
,SUM(op1) op1,SUM(op2) op2,SUM(op3) op3,SUM(op4) op4,SUM(op5) op5
,SUM(op6) op6,SUM(op7) op7,SUM(op8) op8,SUM(op9) op9
FROM s_1ddd_opvisit as {tablename}  {sjoin}
INNER JOIN chospital h ON {tablename}.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE b_year= '{year}' {where} {hospcode} {cmihospcode} {DEP} {fzyymm}
) AS o
GROUP BY c.genericname
ORDER BY  c.genericname
